get_model_release.description: Read a catalog model release using request_id from a queued PIMRelease outcome. Check status and after_product before advancing: done means the scan finished, while failed, cancelled and expired are terminal.

wait_for_product.description: With catalog READ, wait for a live product to match status, channel or locale completeness, or a channel publication state. Advance only when status is matched, or resume a timed_out wait with its returned cursor.

list_publications.description: Read publication changes in sequence order for a channel from PIMSchemaGet or PIMGet publications; requires catalog READ and returns a page of changes and a continuation cursor. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.

list_changes.description: With catalog READ, read product changes and deletion markers in sequence and product id order, then pass next unchanged with the same filters. If gap is present, discard the local replica and omit the cursor to restart, using the catalog id from the call or trait context.

apply.description: Create or change products, hierarchy and terms with catalog WRITE and applicable attribute access. Even when success is true, check applied, every outcome and each finding code before advancing (an atomic refusal applies none, and independent mode can refuse every item).

propose.description: Submit value or status edits for review with catalog READ access and pass the schema generation and product versions you read so a stale base returns a typed conflict. Retry an uncertain submission with the same request and idempotency key to get the original proposal ID and use PIMProposals for current status.

decide.description: Accept or reject a proposal from PIMPropose or PIMProposals with catalog WRITE. Even when success is true, check status and, if result is present, check applied and every outcome and finding code before advancing.

release.description: Release ready items or queue model releases with catalog WRITE. Check every outcome and finding code even when success is true, then track queued requests with PIMModelReleaseGet and verify publication separately.

withdraw.description: Withdraw publications for products from PIMGet with catalog WRITE. Check every outcome and finding code before advancing, even when success is true.

create_catalog.description: Create a catalog owned by the caller with an optional initial schema; requires an authenticated creator. Returns the catalog id and initial generation, with an empty schema when declaration is omitted.

update.description: Set the registered UI app for a catalog, or clear it with an empty ui_app. Requires catalog ADMIN.

plan_schema.description: Classify a declaration using types and plugins from PIMSchemaOptions without applying it; requires catalog ADMIN and returns the plan, compatibility classification and findings. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.

apply_schema.description: Apply a declaration reviewed with PIMSchemaPlan, replacing named entries, keeping omissions and destroying remove entries; requires catalog ADMIN and returns the new generation and change classification. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.

policy_defaults.description: Read deployment policy defaults a catalog inherits from Settings with catalog READ and ADMIN and access to the PIM Settings namespace. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.

configure_plugin.description: Replace configuration or reset projections for an active plugin without changing schema generation; requires catalog ADMIN and returns the command sequence. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.

rebuild.description: Resume a pending catalog materialized view rebuild after failure; requires catalog ADMIN and returns whether rebuilding is pending. Catalog id comes from the call, then trait context when omitted.
